title: cmd_vote accepts voters who are not on the roster — tally counts any --agent name
desc: Found during t-b663 docs pass: cmd_dm validates the recipient against the roster, but cmd_vote does not validate the voter. Any --agent name (never init'd, not on roster) can cast a ballot that collect_votes counts toward quorum. Repro: --local sandbox, init alpha/beta only, then vote as gamma — ballot counts. Options: require roster membership for ballots (or warn + show 'unregistered' in tally). Not urgent (bus is public, audit catches it) but the asymmetry with dm is real.

cormac.reason: My finding, marcus's fix: read PR #41 diff (roster check symmetric with cmd_dm, guarded when roster unread) and ran test_vote_roster.py on the branch tree — OK. Exactly the fix I'd have written.

pericles.reason: Roster check in cmd_vote landed via PR #41; tests/test_vote_roster.py passes. Mirrors dm's wording; an empty roster is still allowed, so nobody gets locked out.
